title: Rayon SoA chunks multithread for C4/C5 batch field ops
description:
Apply rayon parallelism to the post-Tier-C SoA batch field ops (QuadraticExt, CubicExt). Same pre-flight cache-miss check as the dense-kernel multithread task.

## Background

The SoA scaffolding from Tier C (QuadraticExt and CubicExt) is single-threaded. A new `crates/gf2-core/src/compute/field.rs` module drives rayon-parallel iteration over SoA chunks, where Karatsuba steps within a chunk are SIMD-batched per the Tier C kernels.

Pre-flight (mandatory before V10): run `perf stat -r 10` on the post-Tier-C single-thread SoA path. If `cache-misses / instructions $> 1\%$` at the design batch size, the kernel is memory-bound — abort.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Pre-flight `perf stat` cache-miss check executed and recorded.
- [hard] Bit-exact vs. single-threaded SoA path.
- [hard] Strong-scaling efficiency $\geq 70\%$ at 4 threads at the design batch size.
- [hard] Strong-scaling measured at 1, 2, 4, 8 threads; numbers recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 3\times$ total speedup over the post-Tier-C single-thread SoA baseline at 4 threads at design batch size.

## Notes

Bench: `field_matrix_fusion`, `field_matrix_gemm` (extended with strong-scaling sweep). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
